Messages.Author: Patrick van der Reest
Messages.Body:
A minion with the Improvised Flamethrower in combat takes "2 aggravated
(non-strike) damage" when hit at long range by the opposing minion. Does
environmental damage, such as Carrion Crows or Murder of Crows, count in
this regard? I'm honestly not sure whether it's inflicted by the opposing
minion.

Thanks,

Patrick

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


"Environmental" is the term used expressly to describe damage that is not
done "by a minion".

Environmental damage (damage not done by any minion) is not counted.
